content: Salon loyalty programs commonly use point-per-visit/spend, tiered membership, punch cards, or referral rewards, automatically awarded post-appointment/purchase from booking/order history. Key retained metrics are Rebooking Rate and Repeat Client Rate. Deposits and cancellation/no-show fee policies (e.g. 50% late-cancel, 100% no-show) are a related retention/revenue-protection mechanism disclosed at booking time.
